To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) Na+-dependent Ca+ uptake by myocardium cells and N-8 cells is mediated by a carrier, (ii) the properties of the Ca2+ carrier of N-18 cell are similar to those of myocardial cells and (iii) the initial rate of Na+- dependent Ca2+ uptake is much lower in N-18 cells than in myocardial cells.

(1) Ca2+ uptake in myocardial and neuroblastoma cell cultures is dependent on the intracellular concentrations of both Ca2+ and Na+, (2) the carrier for Ca2+ uptake is a saturable system with an apparent K0.5 of 0.1 mM for Ca2+ and (3) the maximal initial rate of Ca-uptake in N-18 cells is about 1/ 100 that in myocardial cells.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the properties of the carrier system for Na+-dependent Ca+ uptake in non-excitable cells.
the kinetic properties of a Na+-dependent Ca+ carrier in the plasma membrane of non-excitable cells.
the Na+-dependent Ca uptake by myocardial and neuroblastoma cell in culture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Na+-Ca2+ carrier of myocardial cells has a similar function and properties in N-18 cells.
the carrier system for Na+-dependent Ca+ uptake by myocardia cells in culture is similar to that in N-18 neuroblastoma cells.
the carrier system of myocardial cells and that of N-18 neuroblastoma cells are similar, but the former is about 100 times more active than the latter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

myocardial cells possess a carrier for Na+-dependent Ca+ uptake, which is similar in properties to that of N-18 neuroblastoma cells, but the carrier in myocardial cells is much more active than that in N-18 cells.
the carrier system of Na+-dependent calcium uptake by N-18 cells is the same as that of myocardium.
myocardial cells and the neuroblastoma cells possess the same Na+-dependent Ca-2+ uptake carrier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Na+-dependent Ca(2+)-uptake system in the N-18 cells has a similar kinetic property to that of the Na+-dependent system in the cardiac cells.
the rate of Ca2+-uptake in the heart is very high, and the rate of Ca-uptake in non-excitable cells is very low.
the rate of Ca2+-transport by the Na+-Ca2+ exchanger is very low in the N-18 cell line, and that the Na+-Ca exchanger is expressed at a much higher level in myocardial cells than in the N-8 cells.
